description: This file defines an interface 'RelationshipsInterface' for handling relationships between modules in a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM extension. It declares methods for loading relationships, retrieving lists, adding, and getting specific relationships.

classes.name: RelationshipsInterface
classes.description: An interface outlining methods for managing module relationships, including finding relatable modules, loading relationships, retrieving lists, and adding relationships.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Static method to find modules that can have relationships.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets information about a specific relationship by name.
